blocks.content: Given three numbers n1, n2, and n3, n1 will be the largest number if:

items: n1 is greater than n2, and

blocks.content: Similarly, you can check if n2 or n3 is largest using the same logic. To solve this problem, you can use the && operator.

Enter the first number: 10  
Enter the second number: 20  
Enter the third number: 5  
The largest number is: 20

Enter the first number: 15  
Enter the second number: 15  
Enter the third number: 10  
The largest number is: 15
